headline: Bharat Electronics shares fall 16% over six months amid broader market correction

headline: India unveils Agni Kalash combat drone with 300km range
hook: New Indian combat drone enters testing phase
summary: The Agni Kalash is a new Indian-made combat drone capable of flying up to 300 kilometers. It features advanced navigation technology that allows it to operate effectively without relying on GPS signals. This development is part of India's push toward self-reliance in defense manufacturing. The drone's ability to function in GPS-denied environments enhances its tactical utility for the Indian Armed Forces.
why_it_matters: Boosts domestic defense manufacturing and indigenous technology capabilities.

headline: DRDO completes successful test of High-Altitude Pseudo-Satellite
hook: New surveillance capability for Indian defense
summary: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has successfully tested a High-Altitude Pseudo-Satellite (HAPS) at an altitude of 21 kilometers. These unmanned airships are designed to remain airborne for months, acting as persistent surveillance platforms and communication relays. The technology aims to enhance India's border monitoring and maritime domain awareness capabilities. This development signals a push toward indigenous aerospace and defense technology self-reliance.
why_it_matters: Boosts long-term prospects for domestic defense manufacturing firms
winners_losers: Defense manufacturers gain / No clear losers
